einzeiler: Creator Anna Blake on financial stability, OnlyFans, and sex work.
kurzfassung: Anna Blake discusses her experience starting an OnlyFans account for financial stability and how it changed her relationship to sex and money. In conversation with Anna Sale, she reflects on her upbringing, job prospects with a G.E.D., and class dynamics in sex work. The discussion covers the realities she faced while making online sex videos.
stichpunkte: Starting an OnlyFans account for financial stability
Realizing a hatred for the work and making little money
Changes in her relationship to sex and money
Homeschooling background and having few job prospects with a G.E.D.
The class conversation missing from the discourse about sex work
beschreibung:
Anna Blake started an OnlyFans account, not as a pleasure project, but to achieve some financial stability. When she found out she hated the work and made little money, her relationship to sex – and to money – had to change.
This week on the show, she talks to Anna Sale about being homeschooled as a kid, having few job prospects as a young adult with a G.E.D., and the class conversation that she feels is missing from the discourse about sex work.
You can read Anna Blake’s writing at nothingseriousbyannablake.substack.com, or you can follow her on TikTok at tiktok.com/@nerdnextdoorbabe.
